question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
-- Final answer: Get the customer name and the max month-over-month difference
WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM (
        SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_paid
        FROM payment
        GROUP BY customer_id
        ORDER BY total_paid DESC
        LIMIT 10
    )
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT t10.customer_id,
           date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) as month,
           SUM(p.amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    JOIN top10 t10 ON p.customer_id = t10.customer_id
    GROUP BY t10.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           month,
           monthly_total,
           LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as prev_month_total,
           LAG(month) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as prev_month
    FROM monthly
),
mom_diffs AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           prev_month,
           month,
           ROUND(monthly_total - prev_month_total, 2) as mom_diff
    FROM with_lag
    WHERE prev_month IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT customer_id, prev_month, month, mom_diff,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mom_diff DESC) as rn
    FROM mom_diffs
)
SELECT r.customer_id,
       c.first_name,
       c.last_name,
       r.prev_month as month_from,
       r.month as month_to,
       r.mom_diff
FROM ranked r
JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
